data.body: RP-06 D6.4 approved with a strict response boundary (2026-08-18): persist the versioned typed discovery trace for retry, audit, and diagnostics, correlated internally by review/run lineage. Do not include per-unit discovery trace/debug detail in review responses or review-status responses. Those output contracts remain narrow end-result projections; preserve their existing fields and verdict semantics rather than adding coverage.discovery or another verbose public projection. Raw prompts, ticket/context material, provider payloads, and secrets remain absent from the stored safe trace as already required. Updated .joe-janitor/rp06-independent-critique.md. No tracked or production file changed.
